description: Given Airflow cross-DAG triggering patterns — TriggerDagRunOperator, ExternalTaskSensor, or a Dataset-based schedule — author the matching Orchestra mechanism: a TRIGGER_PIPELINE task for explicit mid-flow launch-and-wait, or a trigger_events: block for reactive/event-driven patterns.

evals.prompt: Convert this Airflow TriggerDagRunOperator to Orchestra (see files/trigger_dagrun_wait.py). It explicitly triggers the daily_reporting DAG with wait_for_completion=True and conf={"env": "prod"}, and only once that finishes does publish_dashboard run. The daily_reporting DAG has already been migrated to Orchestra as pipeline b2e4f710-1111-4a22-9999-abcdef112233. Model this as a TRIGGER_PIPELINE task inside the orchestration_dag pipeline, sequenced ahead of the dashboard-publishing task. Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live access, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: An orchestration-dag pipeline.yml with an ORCHESTRA/TRIGGER_PIPELINE task (parameters.pipeline_id set to the UUID b2e4f710-1111-4a22-9999-abcdef112233, run_inputs carrying env: prod) that a downstream publish-dashboard task depends_on, since wait_for_completion=True means the source explicitly waits for daily_reporting to finish before continuing — not a trigger_events: block, which would only react rather than block mid-flow.

assertions.text: A task uses the ORCHESTRA integration
A task runs the TRIGGER_PIPELINE job
The TRIGGER_PIPELINE task's pipeline_id is the UUID b2e4f710-1111-4a22-9999-abcdef112233
run_inputs carries over the env: prod value from the source's conf={"env": "prod"}
parameters.pipeline_id is the UUID placeholder, not the literal string 'daily_reporting' — the DAG id is never used as the pipeline_id value
The publish-dashboard task depends_on the TRIGGER_PIPELINE task, preserving the source's launch-and-wait-then-continue ordering
No trigger_events: block is used for this case — wait_for_completion=True explicitly blocks mid-flow, which requires the waiting TRIGGER_PIPELINE task rather than a reactive trigger

evals.prompt: Convert this Airflow ExternalTaskSensor to Orchestra (see files/external_task_sensor_cross_dag.py). daily_report waits for the whole nightly_elt DAG to finish before building the report. nightly_elt has already been migrated to Orchestra as pipeline 9d3a5c20-4444-4b33-8888-abcdef445566. Per this skill's guidance, prefer trigger_events: over a polling sensor since the upstream is already an Orchestra pipeline. Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live access, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: A daily-report pipeline.yml with a root-level trigger_events: entry (type: pipeline, pipeline_id 9d3a5c20-4444-4b33-8888-abcdef445566, statuses including SUCCEEDED) plus a pipeline: block for the build-daily-report task — not a TRIGGER_PIPELINE task, since ExternalTaskSensor maps to a reactive event-driven trigger, not an explicit mid-flow wait.

assertions.text: A trigger_events: block is present at the pipeline root
A pipeline: block with tasks is still present alongside trigger_events
trigger_events entries are typed as pipeline triggers
The upstream pipeline id 9d3a5c20-4444-4b33-8888-abcdef445566 is carried over
SUCCEEDED is among the trigger statuses
No TRIGGER_PIPELINE task is used for this case — trigger_events: is preferred over a polling sensor or a waiting task since the upstream DAG is already an Orchestra pipeline
build_daily_report is still represented as a pipeline: task, not folded into the trigger definition itself

evals.prompt: Convert this Airflow Dataset-based cross-DAG trigger to Orchestra (see files/dataset_trigger.py). orders_summary_consumer is scheduled on the orders_dataset produced by orders_producer's extract_orders task via outlets=[orders_dataset]. orders_producer has already been migrated to Orchestra as pipeline c4f6a830-5555-4c44-9999-abcdef667788. Author the consumer pipeline's trigger_events: block reacting to the producer pipeline completing. Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live access, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: An orders-summary-consumer pipeline.yml with a root-level trigger_events: entry (type: pipeline, pipeline_id c4f6a830-5555-4c44-9999-abcdef667788, statuses including SUCCEEDED) plus a pipeline: block for the build-order-summary task — not a TRIGGER_PIPELINE task, since Airflow Datasets map to reactive trigger_events on the producing pipeline, not an explicit mid-flow wait.

assertions.text: A trigger_events: block is present at the pipeline root
trigger_events entries are typed as pipeline triggers
The producer pipeline id c4f6a830-5555-4c44-9999-abcdef667788 is carried over
SUCCEEDED is among the (explicit or default) trigger statuses
The trigger targets the orders_producer pipeline specifically, matching the Dataset dependency on extract_orders' outlets — not a same-pipeline dependency or a TRIGGER_PIPELINE task
build_order_summary is still represented as a pipeline: task, not folded into the trigger definition itself
